text: Clean the place where you will do the puja.
Spread a clean cloth on a puja peeta and place the picture or idol of Sri Krishna and Satyabhama Devi on it.
If you don't have their picture, you can use a picture of Sri Krishna or Sri Mahavishnu.
If you don't have those either, open Sri Krishna's picture in Pocket Panchangam and meditate on him.
Place a turmeric Ganapati or a Ganapati idol beside it, and get the puja items ready.
